newsitem.title: USA: US Senate leader still concerned by USTR nominee.
newsitem.headline: US Senate leader still concerned by USTR nominee.

text.p: Senate Republican Leader Trent Lott said Thursday he remained concerned about a legal barrier to confirmation of Charlene Barshefsky as U.S. Trade Representative.

The Senate Finance Committee, in voting to recommend her confirmation earlier Thursday, also voted for a waiver in a law that prevents those who have worked for foreign governments from holding the post.
As a private attorney, Barshefsky advised Canada in 1990 on a lumber dispute with the United States.

But Lott told reporters: "I don't think you can lightly dismiss a law that's on the books." He said he would continue to emphasize that the law was there "for a reason" and that he was continuing to review the issue.
